documents.title: Knowledge base
documents.description: Upload a document, choose how it is chunked and embedded, inspect the chunks, then index it. Indexed documents become searchable and can be used to answer questions.
documents.uploadDescription: Chunking runs first and returns a preview. Nothing is searchable until you index the document.
documents.catalogFailed: Could not load the available stages
documents.fileHint: Text, Markdown, code and PDF are supported by the built-in chunkers.
documents.chunkerHint: How the document is split. Choose after looking at the file's structure.
documents.embedderHint: Runs when you index. The stub is offline and deterministic; production embedders download model weights the first time.
documents.chunkSizeHint: Target size in characters. Leave empty to use the server's configured default.
documents.chunkOverlapHint: Characters repeated between neighbouring chunks. Must be smaller than the chunk size.
documents.readOnly: You can browse the knowledge base. Uploading, indexing and deleting require write access.
documents.overlapTooLarge: Overlap must be smaller than the chunk size.
documents.uploadedToast: Stored {{count}} chunks — review them, then index the document.
documents.previewEmpty: The chunker produced no chunks. Try another chunker or a larger chunk size.
documents.previewTruncated: Only the first chunks are shown here; the full set is stored.
documents.indexHint: Indexing runs the embedder and makes the document searchable.
documents.alreadyIndexed: This document is indexed and searchable.
documents.reindexHint: The selected embedder differs from the indexed one; indexing replaces the stored vectors.
documents.deleteConfirmDescription: “{{title}}” and its chunks will be permanently removed.
documents.indexedToast: Indexed {{count}} chunks — the document is searchable.
documents.listDescription: Every document in the shared knowledge base, newest first.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Upload one above.

failure.emptyAfterParse: No text could be extracted from the file.
failure.chunkingFailed: The chunker could not process the file.
failure.embeddingFailed: The embedder failed; the document is not searchable.
failure.unknownEmbedder: The recorded embedder is no longer registered.
failure.noChunks: The document has no chunks to index.

chat.title: Ask the knowledge base
chat.description: Retrieve chunks from the indexed documents, optionally rerank them, and generate a grounded answer with citations. Every stage can be overridden for one question.
chat.questionDescription: Ask about anything in the indexed corpus. A refusal is a real answer: if retrieval finds no relevant context, the generator is not called.
chat.questionPlaceholder: What does the knowledge base say about…?
chat.catalogFailed: Could not load the available stages
chat.embedderHint: Only embedders that produced indexed documents are listed; vectors from different models cannot be compared.
chat.corpusEmpty: No indexed documents yet — index one on the knowledge-base page first.
chat.modeHint: Hybrid fuses the dense and lexical legs; only modes the selected retriever supports are shown.
chat.topKHint: How many chunks retrieval returns before reranking. Empty = server default.
chat.rerankTopKHint: How many chunks the generator sees. Empty = server default.
chat.invalidInteger: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
chat.noHitsHint: Nothing in the indexed documents matched this question closely enough. Try another question, index more documents, or lower the relevance floor.
chat.citationsEmpty: This answer used no context chunks.

admin.title: RAG admin
admin.description: Every document in the shared knowledge base with its ingestion stages, lifecycle state and failure details.
admin.empty: No documents have been uploaded yet.
